title: Read a claimed item's control binding without changing focus
outcome: Read a claimed item's control binding without changing focus
acceptance: A read-only core command (e.g. `engram work core inspect REF --json`) returns the same item view as `work core focus`, including control_binding when the calling session holds the item's live claim, without changing the session's focus, staging or discarding a delivery page, or appending any event
Tests prove focus, delivery state and the project feed are unchanged by the read, and that the binding matches the one `work core focus` returns for the same holder
The CLI docs describe the command as the host's way to read a claim's binding before session_bind
control_binding in that output is null when the caller does not hold a live claim on the item, exactly as in focus

completion.summary: Read-only core inspect returns the holder binding or explicit null exactly as focus, using one read-only snapshot without changing focus, delivery or feed state. Existing service and CLI regressions passed in the retained exact-source full gate; docs agree. Fresh independent assessment passes all5 unchanged criteria, resolving the old exact-as-focus failure after the prerequisite landing.
